notes.title: Happy Official Launch Day!
notes.content:
Woot! Today we celebrate the launch of the first (of many) games for Bonsai LLC! The goal of our company is to make fun, cool, interesting, and/or thought provoking games and donate half our profit to Environmental Organizations. The more games we sell the more we can help our planet in crisis!

Check out some great Environmental Organizations we plan on donating to while your here!

Clean Air Council
Sunrise Movement
Clean Air Task Force
Terra Praxis
